title: daisugi-devnet-0
announcements: daisugi-devnet-0 launched on **2026-11-18 15:00:00 UTC**. The Daisugi fork activates at epoch 10 (**16:04:00 UTC**).

**Scope.** Post-quantum transaction devnet: native frame transactions (EIP-8141) with keyed nonces (EIP-8250) from genesis, and recursive STARK proof aggregation of post-quantum signatures (EIP-8288) from the Daisugi fork. Daisugi is a CL fork on top of **Electra**; Fulu, Gloas, Heze and the BPO forks are not scheduled.
Daisugi is experimental and not a scheduled mainnet fork. The EIP-8288 format follows the Nethermind prototype where the EIP is still open (see [Open questions](#Open-questions)).

eips.title: Recursive STARK proof of post-quantum signatures
